QUICK ANSWERS

Before we talk.

Who should contact TALVUMI?

Pet food importers, national or regional distributors, retail chains, specialist pet retailers and established ecommerce operators.

Can we discuss territory rights?

Yes. Territory is discussed after both sides understand the market plan, channel capability and commercial expectations.

Can consumers buy online today?

Retail availability will open market by market through appointed channels. The current website is focused on partner conversations.
